description: Remove objects from a photo by describing them, for example "the cables on the desk" or "the person on the left". The rest of the image is kept pixel for pixel. Costs 25 credits (enhance 40, paid credits).

format.description: Output format. png keeps transparency everywhere; webp is smaller; jpg has no transparency.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL. Prefer image_url for large files.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a JPG, PNG or WebP image (up to 25 MB). NukeBG downloads the image itself.

prompt.description: What to remove, in plain words.

quality.description: fast (default) or enhance for harder scenes.

name: erase_objects
title: Remove objects
